title: Obby: Three Challenges
desc: THREE LEVELS. ONE CHANCE. NO MERCY. Every great champion starts somewhere. Today, that somewhere is Obby: Three Challenges — a platformer designed to test your reflexes, patience, and determination. • EASY — learn the basics. Find your rhythm. • MEDIUM — the traps get smarter. So must you. • IMPOSSIBLE — only the best will survive. Each level is packed with unique obstacles: spinning blades, deadly drops, and more. With fluid movement, double jumps, and a sprint ability, you have the tools. But do you have the skill? FEATURES: • 3 difficulty levels • Responsive controls — jump, • Visual feedback with particles and sound.
